name_note: The GTDB genus Parolsenella is broader than the published one: besides Parolsenella catena and Parolsenella massiliensis it holds many uncultured species and genomes deposited as Olsenella or Atopobium.

sentences.text: Parolsenella catena is an obligately anaerobic, Gram-stain-positive coccobacillus of the family Atopobiaceae, isolated from a faecal sample of a healthy Japanese man.
A comparative genomics study proposed that Libanicoccus massiliensis be reclassified as Parolsenella massiliensis.
A metagenomic study of 50 Indigenous Australian infants reported higher carriage of Parolsenella species than in age- and sex-matched non-Indigenous infants living in urban Australia.
A study of Pakistani adults reported an increased relative abundance of Libanicoccus/Parolsenella as a gut microbial signature atypical of other populations.
